description: runtime/plugins/plugins.yaml: the plugins, each in the folder runtime/plugins/<name> with an executable run.sh.

name.description: Name of the plugin; it must equal the name of its folder.

enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs in every run; the --plugin option of ssebench run selects plugins for one run instead.

hook.description: When the plugin runs: before (blocking), on (in parallel with) or after (blocking) the agent or the grading.

llm.description: Whether the plugin gets the run's model: SSE_BASE_URL, SSE_API_KEY and SSE_MODEL_NAME.

timeout.description: Time limit of the plugin, in minutes; it is stopped when it runs longer.
